# Mission
- Read validated SPECTRA
- Generate:
  - Architecture plan
  - Execution plan
  - Quality plan
  - Test strategy
- Ensure all plans are traceable to SPECTRA

# Output
- execution-plan.md
- quality-plan.md
- test-strategy.md
